Heavy Rainfall Warning No. 7 #NCR_PRSD
Weather System: Severe Tropical Storm OPONG
Issued at: 8:00 PM, 26 September 2025(Friday)

YELLOW WARNING LEVEL: Batangas(Calatagan, Balayan, Lian, Nasugbu, Tuy, Calaca, Mabini, Tingloy, Bauan, San Luis, Taal, Lemery, Agoncillo, Laurel, San Nicolas, Santa Teresita, Alitagtag, San Pascual).
ASSOCIATED HAZARD: FLOODING in flood-prone areas.
Meanwhile, expect light to moderate rains over Rizal, Metro Manila, Bulacan, Pampanga, Tarlac and Nueva Ecija within the next 3 hours.
Light to moderate with occasional heavy rains affecting Cavite, Bataan, Zambales(Olongapo, Subic, San Marcelino, Castillejos, San Antonio, San Narciso), Batangas(Balete, Batangas City, Tanauan, Cuenca, Ibaan, Lipa, Lobo, Malvar, Mataasnakahoy, Padre Garcia, Rosario, San Jose, San Juan, Santo Tomas, Talisay, Taysan), Quezon(Candelaria, Dolores, San Antonio, Sariaya, Tiaong, Tayabas, Lucban, Lucena, Pagbilao, Sampaloc, Agdangan, Alabat, Atimonan, Buenavista, Burdeos, Calauag, Catanauan, General Luna, Guinayangan, Gumaca, Jomalig, Lopez, Macalelon, Mulanay, Padre Burgos, Panukulan, Patnanungan, Perez, Pitogo, Plaridel, Polillo, Quezon, San Andres, San Francisco, San Narciso, Tagkawayan, Unisan, Mauban) and Laguna(Binan, Santa Rosa, Cabuyao, Calamba, Los Banos, Bay, Alaminos, Calauan, San Pablo) which may persist within 3 hours and may affect nearby areas.

The public and the Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Offices concerned are advised to MONITOR the weather condition and watch for the next warning to be issued at 11:00 PM today.
For more information and queries, please call telephone numbers 8927-1335 and 8927-2877 or log on to https://t.co/59mTpZJq1n.

data.text:
WORST MARK VILLAR PROJECT IN MANILA

Two days ago, sumigaw at nagalit si Sec. Vince Dizon sa mga Manila DPWH engineers.

Hingi kasi sila ng hingi ng budget para sa repair and maintenance ng “Sunog Apog Pumping Station” eh hindi naman gumagana since 2020.

Binigyan sila ng 94 Million ngayong 2025 Budget at humihingi pa ng 200 Million for 2026!

BUT, the project itself was already funded with a whopping 774 Million in 2017.

Nagsimula yung construction nuong 2018 tapos nag inauguration 2020 pero never gumana kahit hanggang ngayon.

According to PhilStar, barangay officials said they never needed the pumping station in the first place. They claimed they were not consulted before construction began.

And sa investigation ni Sec. Vince Dizon, imbes na makatulong eh nakaka perwisyo at dagdag pa yung Pumping Station sa problema ng baha.

Guess who funded and inaugurated the pumping station when he was a DPWH Secretary?

Tahimik lang kayo. Si Mark Villar lang naman.

At proud na proud pa sila niyan ni Rodrigo Duterte ah. Tingnan nyo naman yung bronze marker or plaque.

Ang Congressman duon? Rolando Valeriano.

Ang Mayor nuong 2019-2022? Isko Moreno.

Facts lang.

#Accountability
#FloodControlProjects
